end.summary:
Named earthworm, ant, beetle, and possible woodlouse as soil or leaf-litter animals.
Discussed looking under stones and gently moving leaves to find small animals.
Earthworm classification was discussed repeatedly; Pihu continued to call it an insect.
Teach-back was not passed; the misconception was still present at the last turn.
end.parentNote: Asha practised naming small animals found in soil and leaf litter, using examples such as earthworms, ants, beetles, and woodlice. Pihu connected ants with soil homes and recalled seeing a woodlouse roll up. The mix-up that all small crawling or underground animals are insects was not corrected by the end; at home, sort animal pictures into “insect” and “not an insect,” and discuss what body features support each choice.
